principle: History-first load prescription; conservative profile baseline only when same-movement history is unavailable.

progression.increase: If planned sets reach the top of the target rep range with RIR >= 2, use the movement-specific smallest practical increment.
progression.hold: If the target range is achieved with RIR 1-2, keep the current load and improve repeatability.
progression.reduce: If at least half of performed sets fall below the target minimum or RIR reaches 0, reduce roughly 5-10% and restore quality.
progression.readiness: Readiness below 68 applies a conservative load reduction; pain/red-flag logic can suppress load prescription.

baseline_warning: Bodyweight ratios are app calibration heuristics, not normative strength standards. They are intentionally labeled lower confidence and are replaced by real personal history after the first logged sessions.
